seoTitle: Transfer a Domain From Squarespace to Cloudflare
metaDescription: Move your domain registration from Squarespace to Cloudflare for lower pricing and simpler DNS or CDN management. Full walkthrough.
intro: Transferring a domain from Squarespace to Cloudflare can lower your registration costs and simplify management if you already use Cloudflare for DNS or CDN services. This guide covers preparing your domain for transfer and completing the move from your Cloudflare dashboard.

steps.heading: Log in to Cloudflare
steps.body: Sign in to your Cloudflare account, or sign up and follow the on-screen instructions if you're new to the platform.

steps.heading: Check transfer eligibility
steps.body: Your Squarespace domain typically needs to be at least 60 days old and not recently transferred or renewed, with domain privacy protection disabled.

steps.heading: Start the transfer in Cloudflare
steps.body: Hover over Domain Registration in the sidebar and click Manage Domains to find the transfer option. Verify your email if the option isn't visible yet.

steps.heading: Complete the transfer
steps.body: Follow the on-screen instructions after email verification to move the domain from Squarespace to Cloudflare — most of the technical work is handled automatically.

steps.heading: Manage the domain on the Squarespace side
steps.body: You can also start from Squarespace by going to Settings, then Domains and Email, to review your current domain and registration details before initiating the move.

faq.question: Why transfer a domain from Squarespace to Cloudflare?
faq.answer: Cloudflare often has more competitive domain pricing and lets you consolidate registration with DNS and CDN management in one place.

faq.question: Are there requirements before I can transfer my domain?
faq.answer: Yes — the domain generally needs to be at least 60 days old, not recently transferred or renewed, and have privacy protection disabled.

faq.question: Is the transfer process technical?
faq.answer: No, Cloudflare handles most of the technical steps automatically once you verify your email and follow the prompts.

faq.question: How much does it cost to register a new domain through Squarespace if I don't have one yet?
faq.answer: Pricing starts around $14 per year, though costs vary by domain extension.
